metadata.chapter_subtitle: Measuring mass redistribution from satellite gravity measurements

inventory.summary: The chapter needed a clearer opening distinction between direct observation and inferred mass change from gravity anomalies.
issues: The chapter lacked the standard onboarding block.
The indirect nature of GRACE measurement needed stronger early framing.
The specialist inversion workflow benefited from a simpler conceptual anchor.

rewrite.summary: Completed a full editorial pass that added onboarding and clarified GRACE as an inference from satellite motion rather than direct groundwater observation.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Clarified that GRACE senses gravity change rather than seeing water directly.
Improved the conceptual lead-in to the inversion workflow.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now introduces the indirect measurement logic more clearly while preserving the advanced gravity-field content.

repair.summary: The chapter's conceptual anchor was strengthened during the editorial pass.
actions_taken: Clarified that GRACE products are inferred from gravity anomalies.
Improved the transition from orbital motion to water-storage interpretation.

design_review.summary: The chapter's mass-change storyline and coarse-resolution interpretation now have stronger explanatory support.
improvements_made: Improved interpretive support around what GRACE can and cannot resolve directly.
